The scope is restricted to documentary comparison of approved artifacts, definition of required aggregated metrics, and preservation of the post-R6 baseline without any operational execution, patch, sandbox action, or production change.

post_r6_constraints: Do not reopen or reinterpret R6 as authorization for R2.
Do not touch cache_observability_windows beyond preserving it as stable baseline evidence.
Do not touch production, the real project, .mcp.json, the local bridge, bindings, or any real workspace linkage.
Do not introduce PII; only aggregated CRM metrics and documentary evidence are in scope.
Do not use ambiguous SQLite or CRM surfaces as truth without explicit anchoring.
Do not perform sandbox actions, writes, SQL execution, DDL, DML, rollback, or validation runs in this phase.
